# Perfictus

> Perfictus is a Shopify development agency and Shopify Partner. We design, build and grow Shopify and Shopify Plus stores for brands in India, Kuwait, the GCC, the United Kingdom and the United States, and we build iOS and Android mobile apps for e-commerce, grocery and delivery businesses.

Contact: info@perfictus.com · +91-7708621961 (India) · +965-60360675 (Kuwait) · https://perfictus.com/contact

## Services
- [Shopify Development](https://perfictus.com/shopify-development): store setup, custom Shopify themes (Liquid, Online Store 2.0), Shopify Plus, checkout extensibility, Shopify Functions, migrations from WooCommerce/Magento/BigCommerce without losing SEO, custom Shopify apps, Shopify SEO and speed optimisation.
- [Mobile App Development](https://perfictus.com/mobile-app-development): cross-platform iOS and Android apps, Shopify-connected shopping apps, grocery and delivery apps, payment gateways (MyFatoorah, KNET, Apple Pay, Google Pay), App Store and Google Play publishing.
- [All services](https://perfictus.com/service): also SEO, digital marketing, marketplace and aggregator setup, remote developers, graphic design and video editing.

## Company
- [Portfolio](https://perfictus.com/portfolio): Shopify stores (Tingle Tots – India, Boba Tea – UK, The Mom Chic – USA) and the Yamama Asian Mart app (Kuwait).

Here is what changed, what can break and how to fix tracking and upsells.
